routes.title: Modern Languages and Cultures – Arabic Immersion
routes.source_observation: Ordinary public Chrome page; full rendered overview, current curriculum table and all footnotes. Source is dynamic; raw HTTP shell alone does not establish these rules.
routes.evidence_locator: Overview / Notes about this immersion / plan code / Curriculum for 2026-2027 / Course List / numbered footnotes
routes.selection_rule: Three consecutive language courses, or two consecutive language courses and one listed culture course used as a substitution.
routes.placement_rule: Prior language experience requires a placement examination before enrollment. The overview also requires prior-skill students to consult the minor adviser for placement evaluation before registration.
excluded_students: Global futures students selecting the Arabic language area or Middle East field specialization.
routes.overlap_rule: The three related general-education courses must be outside the major and may not overlap program requirements.

culture_substitution.name: Global Islam
conditions: Offered only at the Dubai global campus.

culture_substitution.name: Culture and Politics in the Middle East
conditions: Offered only at the Dubai global campus.

culture_substitution.name: Topics in Global Art and Architecture:
conditions: Offered only at the Kosovo and Dubai global campuses.
Eligible topic: Islamic Art and Architecture.

culture_substitution.name: Special Seminar in History
conditions: Offered only at the Kosovo and Dubai global campuses.

scope_notes: None of these optional immersion courses is a universal AI BS requirement.
The curriculum table leaves individual course hours blank; group/total hours do not establish individual course credits.
Course cards, actual descriptions, and full course prerequisites remain unreviewed in this contribution.
Consecutive study and placement are source conditions, not inferred numeric-code prerequisite chains.
routes.source_exclusion_text: This immersion is closed to students majoring in global futures who have chosen an area of study in Arabic language, a field specialization in the Middle East, or are native speakers of Arabic.
